items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: He used to book different bands. Joe Robichaux and our band and some other bands.

ctx.x: You know, that man used to book us, too. But I can't recall his name. He had a dancing place right on the corner of the rampart. Right by the station. It was two-story building. We took that picture in that place.
